_note: Ground-truth labels for the 153 live USDA search queries in search-core.json, written by a labeler who did not see src/food/common.ts: they were labeled independently of the curated table. Per query: best is the record people most likely mean (null when no SR Legacy or Foundation record fits), acceptable lists records within about 25% of best's calories in the same as-eaten form, disasters lists live hits that would log the wrong food or a badly wrong amount (dried, raw where cooked is meant, a different food sharing a word), defaultAmount is what a unitless mention means. Saved verbatim; test/eval-live.test.ts scores the app against them.
